name: openbb_etf_holdings
description:
Holdings of one ETF through the OpenBB Platform (obb.etf.holdings).
Returns: {symbol, holdings_count (all holdings), holdings: the first 50 records with symbol, name, weight, shares, value and provider extras}.
Inputs (* required): symbol* (ETF ticker, e.g. SPY, QQQ, VTI; default SPY); provider (fmp or intrinio, both need a key; default fmp).
Sector and country weights: openbb_etf_sectors, openbb_etf_countries; fund facts: yf_etf_info, openbb_etf_info. Keys: fmp, benzinga, fred, intrinio, polygon and tiingo need credentials in OpenBB's settings (~/.openbb_platform/user_settings.json), not supplied by SAJHA; yfinance, oecd, federal_reserve, sec, imf and government_us need none.
Example: {"symbol": "QQQ", "provider": "fmp"}

symbol.description: ETF ticker (e.g., SPY, QQQ, VTI, IWM)
